description_sq:
Vile ne shitje ne Rrugen Haxhi DAlliu, prane Stacionit te Trenit!
Vila ka siperfaqe trualli 360m2 dhe siperfaqe neto ndertimi 240 m2
Eshte e organizuar ne dy kate:
-kati i pare me siperfaqe 120m2 organizonet ne dy dhoma, veranden dhe nje tualet;

title_en: Villa - For Sale - Haxhi Hysendalliu Street, Tirana ID: 530181003-413
description_en: Villa for sale in Haxhi Dalliu Street, near the Train Station! The villa has a land area of ​​360 m2 and a net construction area of ​​240 m2. It is organized in two floors: - the first floor with an area of ​​120 m2 is organized in two rooms, a veranda and a toilet; - the second floor with an area of ​​120m2 is organized into three rooms, a veranda and a toilet; The villa also has a spacious and green yard. The area in which the villa is located, very close to the center of Tirana, quiet and lush makes it very suitable for a comfortable life as well as for investment. The villa is equipped with Ownership Certificates.
